purpose: Bounded cache-only semantic validation of the J1 standard-TTFT/request-average-TPOT ledger against a pre-existing nominal-diagnostic HELIX cache grid.

reference_semantics.average_tpot: last Increment completion minus first Increment completion, divided by output_tokens-1
reference_semantics.workload_rule: all requests must pass applicable limits (classification target=1.0)
reference_semantics.accounting_alignment: reconstructed standard endpoints plus the same explicit fixed/queue charge used by J1; no evaluator H or recovered blocking correction is added to the execution reference

reported_metrics: maximum standard TTFT and average TPOT diagnostics
scope_limits: Pilot target grid is restricted to seed/placement/intensity points already used by the pre-existing nominal-gap diagnostic; cache misses abort rather than launch HELIX
protocol_amendment: Revision 2 after the first cache-only run aborted before producing scientific results: the original 72-point target included uncached seed/intensity combinations. The revised 42-point grid uses the pre-existing nominal_gap.py seed/placement/intensity family only; no outcome-based selection and no HELIX execution.
